name: Judaism
overview: Judaism, the religion of the Jews, is foundational to the Gospel as it sets the stage for the new covenant God promised through Jeremiah, fulfilled in Christ, the son of David and Abraham. Jesus affirmed the enduring authority of the Law and the Prophets, emphasizing that He came not to abolish but to fulfill them. Believers are called to genuine repentance and must not rely solely on their heritage as children of Abraham, for God can raise up true descendants by faith. This highlights the need to yield to the Gospel, distinguishing it from corruptions such as Judaizers who distorted Christianity.
